_comment: P3-4 OpenVINO bodies EN（2026-11-03）。sections 与源侧固定小节对齐；sources 按索引对齐 frontmatter。

axes.model_access: Runs models after conversion to OpenVINO IR; supports Intel CPU, GPU and NPU. The supported model and operator list follows official docs and is not enumerated here.
axes.runtime: Runtime library plus Model Server (OVMS): OVMS can expose an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and be deployed with Docker; it runs on local, edge and server hardware.
axes.local_files: Self-hosted, with models and IR files on the local machine; no cloud account dependency.
axes.background: Runtime is a library while OVMS is a long-running service; long tasks and concurrency are orchestrated by the deployer.
axes.tools: OVMS provides OpenAI-compatible endpoints; tool-calling and MCP support not verified item by item.
axes.context: Long context depends on model and memory configuration; KV cache and continuous batching live in official docs.
axes.permissions: Local/self-hosted with no account system; authentication and quotas are configured by the deployer.
axes.fit: Fits Intel CPU/GPU/NPU, edge deployment and squeezing models onto local hardware. Does not fit NVIDIA-only optimisation (TensorRT-LLM/vLLM are more direct) or download-and-run GGUF.

runs: This site has not completed throughput or VRAM tests; the conclusions cover runtime capability and licensing only.
unknowns:
- Current supported model and operator list (not enumerated here)
- OVMS tool-calling and MCP support status
- Acceleration matrix by hardware model
related: An AMD-side local inference server, contrasting with the Intel route.
Another route that distributes and runs models through containers.
sources: OpenVINO · Model Server docs (OVMS / OpenAI-compatible endpoints)
